# Load packages
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

# Load penguin dataset
```{r}
getwd()
penguins <- read_csv(here::here("data/penguins.csv"))
```
# Initial investigations
```{r}
head(penguins)
str(penguins)
```

# Convert chr vars to fcts
```{r}
penguins <- penguins |> 
  mutate(species = as_factor(species),
         island = as_factor(island),
         sex = as_factor(sex))
```

# Check distribution of males to females
```{r}
penguins |> 
  group_by(species, sex, island) |> 
  summarise(total_count


```
